A model that describes the above behaviour has several elements and assumptions [22]. For the purpose of calculating the mean velocity in the layer, the particles are assumed to be completely segregated with the small particles at the bottom. The velocity profile is assumed to be piecewise linear with the velocity gradient inversely proportional to the square of the particle diameter. Further, to take into account the variation of the surface angle with the composition of the flowing layer in a simple way, each half of the free surface is allowed to pivot about a point. The depth averaged, unsteady mass, momentum and species balance equations for the layer are solved simultaneously to obtain the dynamic variation of the flow and concentration in the system.
